messages.subject_clean: Addition of Categorical Variables in Wallace
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,
I would like to ask how one can add categorical variables into wallace while working online. Though there is an option to choose different bioclim variables, I am a bit confused on how to add categorical variables like LULC, geological data into the system?
Another question is can we do correlation tests in Wallace itself?

Thank you in advance

Arjun Nepal (Mr.)
Adjunct Faculty/Environmental Consultant
Royal University of Bhutan
College of Natural Resources, Punakha
Mobile no: +975_17553882
Alternative Email: nepaala...@yahoo.com

messages.subject: Re: Addition of Categorical Variables in Wallace
messages.subject_clean: Addition of Categorical Variables in Wallace
messages.body_plain:
Dear Arjun,

If you want to use categorical variables + climatic variables (e.g., Worldclim), you need to upload all of them using the user-specified option in the Env data component. Then, you must define the set of categorical variables in the Maxent module (Model component). Keep in mind that this option is just available in the dev version (https://wallaceecomod.github.io/wallace/articles/beta-testing.html).

There is no module in Wallace that can do this analysis for the correlation test.

Best,
Gonzalo
